GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2015-06-01T19:31:47Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Function type error in union type
Description: I have been having issues with union types when using a function type as the second type in the union.

According to the TypeScript 1.4 Language Specification: (3.4 Union Types, page 29)
- A | B is equivalent to B | A

The following example compiles correctly:

``` typescript
function test(x: (y) => boolean | boolean) {
    //do something with x
}
```

But this one gives an error:

``` typescript
function test(x: boolean | (y) => boolean) {
    //do something with x
}
```
